model.stdout: Raspberry Pi 3 Model B Plus Rev 1.3

controllers.stdout:
GPIO chips:
  3f200000: bcm2835 (54 gpios)
  0: firmware (8 gpios)

boot_config.stdout:
# For more options and information see
# http://rptl.io/configtxt
# Some settings may impact device functionality. See link above for details

# Uncomment some or all of these to enable the optional hardware interfaces
#dtparam=i2c_arm=on
#dtparam=i2s=on
#dtparam=spi=on

# Enable audio (loads snd_bcm2835)
dtparam=audio=on

# Additional overlays and parameters are documented
# /boot/firmware/overlays/README

# Automatically load overlays for detected cameras
camera_auto_detect=1

# Automatically load overlays for detected DSI displays
display_auto_detect=1

# Automatically load initramfs files, if found
auto_initramfs=1

# Enable DRM VC4 V3D driver
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d
max_framebuffers=2

# Don't have the firmware create an initial video= setting in cmdline.txt.
# Use the kernel's default instead.
disable_fw_kms_setup=1

# Run in 64-bit mode
arm_64bit=1

# Disable compensation for displays with overscan
disable_overscan=1

# Run as fast as firmware / board allows
arm_boost=1

[cm4]
# Enable host mode on the 2711 built-in XHCI USB controller.
# This line should be removed if the legacy DWC2 controller is required
# (e.g. for USB device mode) or if USB support is not required.
otg_mode=1

[cm5]
dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=host

[pi5]
dtoverlay=nospi10

[all]

# WindTunnel: C1815 inverts fan PWM; GPIO18 HIGH requests fan STOP.
# Applied by firmware, not a guarantee during power-on/reset before firmware.
gpio=18=op,dh

fan_stop_unit.stdout:
# /etc/systemd/system/windtunnel-fan-stop.service
[Unit]
Description=Keep WindTunnel inverted fan control at STOP on boot and shutdown
Documentation=https://www.raspberrypi.com/documentation/computers/config_txt.html
DefaultDependencies=no
After=local-fs.target
Before=sysinit.target shutdown.target
Conflicts=shutdown.target
ConditionPathExists=/usr/bin/pinctrl

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/pinctrl set 18 op dh
ExecStop=/usr/bin/pinctrl set 18 op dh
RemainAfterExit=yes
TimeoutStartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=sysinit.target
